 Madden 27 Week 11 Roster Update Release Date
 ClutchPoints Massimo Marchiano, ClutchPoints Tue, November 17, 2026 at 7:20 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Tue, November 17, 2026 at 7:20 PM UTC ClutchPoints Madden 27 Week 11 Roster Update Release Date appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . 
 The Madden 27 Week 11 Roster Update Release Date arrives soon, giving players the most up-to-date rosters to use in-game. Generally, these updates take into account any trades, FA signings, injuries, and other roster changes. However, these Roster Updates do not make any gameplay updates or fixes. Nevertheless, it's nice to use the game's most updated rosters before competing with your friends. Without further ado, let's look at the Madden 27 Week 11 Roster Update release date.
 Madden 27 Week 11 Roster Update Release Date 
 We expect the Madden 27 Week 10 Roster Update Release Date to arrive on Thursday, November 19th, 2026. The updates typically arrive before the Thursday Night Football game of the week. Therefore, we can expect to see it drop before the Houston Texans host the Indianapolis Colts on Thursday night. Regardless, the latest roster update should be out before the games begin on Sunday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Additionally, make sure you know how to update your rosters in Madden 27. If you like, check out our guide on how to do so. Overall, the process takes just a few moments and only requires an internet connection. Once complete, you'll have the latest rosters from EA Sports.
 Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) 
 Speaking of Week 11, it begins with a divisional battle between the Colts and the Texans. Both teams only have just three wins and are just 2-3 losses away from their season being over. Indianapolis won their first meeting back in Week 3, and perhaps another win here can maybe spark some sort of rejuvenation. Meanwhile, the Texans started the season 0-4 and have since gone 3-2. While they still face an uphill battle at 3-6, there's still hope on Houston's sideline.
 On Sunday, we have a few interesting matchups, including a primetime matchup between the Vikings and 49ers. Minnesota's offense looks much better with Kirk Cousins back behind the wheel, and he couldn't have come at a better time. The end of the season is soon approaching and the NFC North throne is still up for grabs. But the 49ers want a win just as badly as they're aiming for the #1 seed in the NFC.
 Advertisement Advertisement Speaking of the NFC North, the Packers are on bye, but the Bears and Lions will be hosting NFC South teams this weekend. The Bears host the Saints, and the Lions host the Buccaneers, both of whom are 3-6. However, the Buccaneers have gone 3-2 since their 0-4 start, and all three of the Saints' wins have been against teams who had a winning-record at the time. Nevertheless, we look forward to seeing how it all plays out on Sunday.
 Lastly, Week 10 ends with a Monday Night matchup between the Bengals and Commanders. Although the Bengals are favored to win, this feels very much like a trap game. The Commanders just beat the Giants and won two of their last three games. They can potentially turn things around by getting a win over one of the best teams in the league. However, it won't be easy taking down Joe Burrow and Ja'Marr Chase, who have been on fire this year.
 There's all sorts of exciting matchups in Week 11, and we can't wait to see what happens.
 Click Above to Subscribe Overall, that includes everything we know about the Madden 27 Week 11 Roster Update Release Date . Feel free to check out some of our Madden 27 guides on passing , catching and kicking the ball . And we look forward to another week of Football which starts this Thursday.
